headline: Sensex drops over 700 points, Nifty falls below 25,200 as profit-taking hits Titan and metals

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Investors booked profits across sectors following recent sharp market rallies.
Metal pack experienced heavy selling pressure, falling around 2%.
Heavyweight stock Titan Company tanked 5%, dragging benchmark indices lower.
Weakness in consumer durables and major IT stocks weighed heavily on Nifty.
whatHappening: Sensex dropped over 700 points, while Nifty 50 slipped below the 25,200 mark.
Titan Company emerged as a major loser, plummeting 5% in trading.
Metals and durables sectors led overall market losses during early trade.
TCS and Titan Company featured among the top drag factors on benchmark indices.
summary:
Indian stock markets faced a sharp downturn as Sensex dropped over 700 points on profit-taking.
The sell-off was led by metals and consumer durables sectors following recent market rallies.
Titan Company slumped 5% and TCS traded lower, pushing Nifty 50 below the 25,200 level.
